shared_elements: marks worked into a natural stone surface
quadruped animal seen from the side (loosely readable in A)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both are stone surfaces bearing worked animal-like figures rendered with linear detail, and in each case a quadruped in profile can be read. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a single faint, shallowly pecked/scratched figure floating alone on a mottled dark rock face, while B is a deeply carved relief pillar organised into stacked registers with a band of arch motifs, a hatched fringe and multiple distinct creatures in bold raised modelling.
